description: Most a sole proprietor or single-member LLC owner can put into a SEP IRA vs a Solo 401(k) for 2026 (IRS Pub. 560 rate worksheet, 2026 limits: $72,000 total, $24,500 deferral, $8,000 catch-up at 50+, $11,250 at 60-63), plus estimated income tax saved. Planning estimate, not tax or investment advice.

age_group.description: Age at the end of 2026 (default under50)

bracket.description: Marginal federal income tax bracket % for the tax-saved estimate (default 22)

net_profit.description: 2026 net self-employment profit (Schedule C line 31), USD

other_deferrals.description: 401(k)/403(b) employee deferrals already made at another job this year

plan_rate.description: Employer contribution rate % in the plan (default 25)

w2_wages.description: W-2 wages from another job (uses up the Social Security wage base)

name: retirement_contribution
title: 2026 SEP IRA vs Solo 401(k) max contribution
